scope.active_ring_sampling_caveat: Active ring thread counts are observer samples and diagnostic only; they do not replace route or CPU acceptance gates.
scope.cache_order_caveat: The same COW upper/work set and host page cache are reused across worker arms in fixed order; interpret the results as a matched diagnostic rather than a cold-cache estimate.
scope.capacity_rejection_caveat: HTTP-429 attempts are retained in rejected_rows, not the accepted timing table. Their partial successes are not presented as clean throughput measurements.
scope.claim: Matched diagnostic of configured Veortex ring-worker limits 1 and 3 on the same three shared CPUs per node, across the declared batch/concurrency matrix.
scope.counter_caveat: Runtime observer CPU sampling covers warmup, dispatch, and drain. Per-node cumulative scan-stage timers are summed and can overlap across worker threads; they are not request latency, CPU time, or physical memory traffic.
scope.cpu_attribution_caveat: Whole-process CPU equivalents are the robust process-level measure. Named query-compute role and stable ring-thread samples are diagnostic: short-lived or renamed threads may be missed, so un-attributed CPU is not a pure support or I/O measurement.
does_not_claim: causal performance attribution independent of run order, host I/O, or cache state
fresh-holdout retrieval recall; the fixed 1,024-query oracle set is repeated across cells
three workers as three additional CPU cores; both profiles share the same three-CPU quota and masks
scope.timing_method: Closed-loop successful HTTP responses divided by monotonic measurement time; each point uses 16 warmups, a configured 30-second dispatch window, and drain before final counters.

publication_clarifications.distinct_ring_tids: Counts span the full window, including replacement threads, and are not simultaneous ring occupancy.
publication_clarifications.cpu_residual: Whole-process minus stable named-ring intervals may include untracked transient ring CPU; it is not pure I/O or support CPU.
publication_clarifications.dispatch_adjudication: Pinned Go source enforces configured 30-second deadline. Last-dispatch offset has no arbitrary 29.9-second lower bound. Raw row15 remains rejected; curated adjudication is explicit.
publication_clarifications.startup_order: Three sequential COW startups, fixed 16-request warmups, no host page-cache reset; not randomized paired runs.
